info.name: Pact of the Feral Sphinx
info.description: Pact of the Feral Sphinx warlock subclass — ATÉRIOR.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: A pact struck not through ritual but through survival — cornered by something that should have eaten you, and didn't, because you turned out to be more interesting alive.

Feral sphinxes are not divine, not singular, not connected in any way to the twelve Legendary Sphinxes. A pact with one never starts as a negotiation. It starts as an attack, and somewhere in that encounter, the sphinx decides you're more interesting kept than eaten.
What's owed is rarely clear. What's certain is that the resemblance only deepens from here.

description.p: Advantage on Initiative rolls. You can't be surprised while conscious.

p.em: 3rd-level Pact of the Feral Sphinx feature

description.p: As an Action, choose a creature within 30 feet that can hear you. It makes a Wisdom saving throw (your Warlock spell save DC) or is Bound by the Riddle until the end of your next turn — unable to willingly move farther from you, with disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.

sheet.description: Choose a creature within 30 feet that can hear you. It makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is Bound by the Riddle until the end of your next turn — unable to willingly move farther from you, with disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.

p.em: 3rd-level Pact of the Feral Sphinx feature

description.p: You learn the Primal Savagery cantrip; Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

p.em: 6th-level Pact of the Feral Sphinx feature

description.p: When you expend a Pact Magic spell slot, choose one Aspect below to empower your next weapon attack or unarmed strike, lasting until the end of your next turn.

tr.td: Triple jump distance; no Opportunity Attacks from movement this turn.
Next hit Frightens (your spell save DC) until your next turn.

sheet.description: When you expend a Pact Magic spell slot, choose one Aspect to empower your next weapon attack or unarmed strike until the end of your next turn: Sphinx Wings (triple jump distance, no Opportunity Attacks from movement), Sphinx Horns (+1d8 Force, push 10 ft.), Sphinx Claws (+1d8 Slashing, knock Prone), or Sphinx Eyes (Frighten until your next turn, save DC yours).

p.em: 10th-level Pact of the Feral Sphinx feature

description.p: A Sphinx does not question whether it is capable. It expects reality to agree. Once per turn, when you fail an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can add your Charisma modifier to the roll — potentially turning the failure into a success. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

sheet.description: Once per turn, when you fail an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can add your Charisma modifier to the roll — potentially turning the failure into a success.

p.em: 10th-level Pact of the Feral Sphinx feature

tr.td: Gain a flying Speed equal to your walking Speed until the end of your next turn.
Next hit: +2d8 Slashing, knock Prone and it can't stand until your next turn.
The Frightened target has disadvantage on the save; you have advantage against it.

sheet.description: Your Aspects improve: Sphinx Wings grants a flying Speed equal to your walking Speed; Sphinx Horns becomes +2d8 Force and push 15 ft.; Sphinx Claws becomes +2d8 Slashing and the target can't stand until your next turn; Sphinx Eyes gives the target disadvantage on its save and you advantage against it.

p.em: 14th-level Pact of the Feral Sphinx feature

description.p: When you expend a Pact Magic spell slot, transform into your Feral Sphinx Form as a Bonus Action — once per Long Rest, separate from Aspect's own uses. Lasts 1 minute, until you revert (Bonus Action), or until the form drops to 0 hit points. Temporary hit points are lost first and don't carry back to your normal form; if the form itself hits 0, the transformation ends and excess damage doesn't carry over either.

sheet.description: When you expend a Pact Magic spell slot, transform into your Feral Sphinx Form for 1 minute, until you revert, or until the form drops to 0 hit points.

ul.li: AC 13 + your Dexterity modifier, or your own AC, whichever is higher
Senses Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception as your own
Strength Override. If your own Strength score is higher than 19, use your own score instead.

Retained Traits. You keep your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, alignment, personality, Proficiency Bonus, Warlock spellcasting, and Pride of the Sphinx. Your gear merges into this form and can't be used.
Four Aspects. All four Aspects of the Feral Sphinx — Wings, Horns, Claws, and Eyes — are active simultaneously, using their 10th-level values, with no spell slot cost to trigger them.
Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10 + your Strength modifier Slashing damage.
Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage.

Sphinx's Malice (Spellcasting). In place of your normal spell list, you can cast the following using your Pact Magic slots, requiring no components (minimum slot level shown): Shatter (2nd), Lightning Bolt (3rd), Fireball (3rd), Confusion (4th), Synaptic Static (5th), Eyebite (6th).
